status: bounded source extraction plus Q24 Web choices; no original-client or game-runtime test

scope.excluded: 7 standard-game tiny-building items, ordinary worker construction/upgrade economics, skill-summoned combat units, missing shop prices, native virtual-menu refund semantics, draw-item last-charge/reward ordering and every other map reward caller
additionalBoundaries: Ordinary physical shop full-inventory admission, including scripted charge stacks

order-registration.fact: Player(0..3) issued-point-order condition is installed by Skill_Trig_Init.

construction-finish.fact: Construction/upgrade finish calls registration and abilities/task bookkeeping; no target-price resource debit.

spell-use.fact: Custom item ability dispatcher has no I5xx/I6xx/I7xx summon-card handler and no player-resource debit.

item-use.fact: Use-item dispatcher branches on keys, i330/i332, i237 and y006/y008/y010, not these AIbl card IDs.

card-carrier-restriction.fact: Non-worker and non-circle carriers with item Level>10 remove/drop the manipulated item and return.

initial-choice.fact: One-time flag is set before creation/add; later SetPlayerState targets Player(11), not the recipient.

initial-item-rewards.fact: I004 sequentially gives i401,i411,i411 and SHOPITEM01 i412; I006 gives one selected damaged sword. No add-return check.

r-exchange.fact: Delete menu item; fewer than five Level12 cards returns; otherwise delete five cards then create/add selected c-card.

recipe-delivery.fact: Consume matched ingredients first; create result at carrier XY; optional charge inheritance; add-result ignored; no rollback.

activity-delivery.fact: Explicit -100 ActScore precedes create/add; failure of add has no refund branch.

stack-after-pickup.fact: Whitelisted stacking is in Item_Get, after pickup and recipe attempt; no source basis to run it when adding fails.

blizzard-add-wrapper.fact: UnitAddItemByIdSwapped creates at recipient XY, calls native add without testing return, returns the created item.

refund-constants.fact: ConstructionRefundRate=1.0 and UpgradeRefundRate=1.0. No evidence of refunding a consumed summon-card charge here.

official-consumption.supports: Charged items disappear after charges are used; consumed items disappear after one use; ground items are actual objects. Does not specify script-native full-inventory or AIbl failure order.

official-tiny-building.supports: Tiny Great Hall/ivory tower creates the indicated building at a location; building takes time. Does not establish cost/failure behavior for custom AIbl cards.

construction-duration-fields.fact: All 87 custom rows omit Dur1/HeroDur1; all target bldtm=1. No inherited effective native duration is asserted.

construction-cancel-library.fact: Only construct start/cancel registrations found in generic MeleeInitVictoryDefeat library. Cancel callback passes GetCancelledStructure to MeleeCheckLostUnit; no map-specific consumed-card restoration found. Negative static finding does not establish engine refunds.

stack-whitelist.fact: 14 item IDs constructed, not every Charged-class object. Decompiler extra registers after the 14th value are not extra whitelist members.

has-item-excludes-manipulated.fact: Scan slots 0..5; return first same type that differs from GetManipulatedItem; otherwise nil.

official-tiny-no-worker.supports: Standard Tiny Great Hall can build an expansion without a Peon; does not resolve this map custom duration/race workflow.

official-construction-refunds.supports: Describes ordinary construction refunds as resources; does not prove consumed AIbl card restoration or the cost basis for this map.

official-inventory-capacity.supports: Six hero slots, one item per slot; powerups automatically used on pickup. Does not define this map shop admission with scripted stacking.

webRules.status: explicit Web choices under Q24; not measured Warcraft native behavior

S01.scope: Using an already-acquired custom AIbl summon card
S01.reason: No target-price debit in investigated map handlers; avoid charging both item acquisition and unrelated unit object price. This is a Web choice, not missing-field defaulting.

S02.scriptOrderCheck: Worker/circle point-slot command; terrain reject first, then usedFood+currentItemHP>foodCapCeiling rejects. Equality passes.
S02.webNativeReplacementCheck: At actual placement/creation commit, recheck known permissions, item still owned and charge>=1, placement still valid, original current-HP test, and usedFood+target.fused<=foodCapCeiling. The additional fused test substitutes unknown native admission behavior; it is not claimed as Lua.
S02.commit: Create exactly one target unit and add its fused to used population in the same battle-time operation as charge-=1. Delete the perishable item only if charge reaches zero. Construction-finish does not add population again.
S02.failureBeforeCommit: No card-charge debit, no population debit and no extra resource debit. Cancelled selection, failed terrain/occupancy check, disappearing issuer/card and concurrent loss of free population are failures before commit. Prior acquisition charges remain paid.
S02.afterCommit: Constructing unit follows S03/S04. Death/destruction or recycle after completion does not restore a card. Explicit voluntary cancellation while constructing refunds exactly the charge consumed by this commit under S04.
S02.sameTimestampCommands: Serialize by the chosen battle event queue; each commit sees updated population. Preview is not a reservation.
S02.missingFields: Do not silently set missing target fused, item charges, prices or duration to zero. All 149 indexed cards have explicit fused and initial uses=1.

D01.scope: Explicit CreateItem then UnitAddItem and equivalent wrapper, plus S04 refund insertion. Does not override explicit RemoveItem/UnitRemoveItem. Ordinary shop admission uses D02.
D01.creation: Create the selected item instance exactly once at the original script X/Y, with its selected identity and existing charges.
D01.emptySlot: Use the lowest-numbered empty slot 0..5; install the item then synchronously execute its pickup handler. Respect script removals, drops, recipes and charge merges, including nested pickup on created recipe results.
D01.fullInventory: If no empty slot at the add call, return false, keep the instance at its original creation X/Y, and do not run Item_Get for that failed insertion. No pre-merge or ground-item recipe matching.
D01.economicEffects: Do not refund already-consumed materials/currency, reset one-time flags, reroll or recreate solely because adding fails. Ground output and preceding debit/flag are one completed operation.
D01.existingItem: Do not overwrite unrelated items to make space.
D01.persistence: Persist ground instance identity, position and charges with the already-completed reward/recipe/exchange operation to prevent duplicate rewards on resume.

S03.status: Q24 Web choice, not original-client measurement
S03.scope: The 87 custom AIbl targets indexed in constructionEvidence
S03.durationSource: target bldtm used explicitly for Web; not an asserted AIbl native fallback
S03.start: At S02 commit, create constructing instance, occupy site, charge food once, and enqueue one finish at commitTime+1000000 microseconds under B05.
S03.workerDependency: No continued channel, proximity, additional worker or target-race-specific worker workflow required after commit.
S03.damageStatus: Construction adds no override to otherwise defined vulnerability/invulnerability.
S03.finish: If same instance still constructing, transition ready and synchronously execute original construction-finish handler exactly once; no second food debit. Preserve native-hero-or-n208 qualification predicate and its random draw at finish, not earlier.
S03.destroyed: If destroyed or removed first, invalidate finish, release its charged food once, no card refund.
S03.clockAndSave: Battle clock, pause/speed per baseline. Persist state, finish event identity/deadline or remaining battle time; load does not recreate unit or fire completion twice.

S04.status: Q24 Web choice, not inferred from ConstructionRefundRate
S04.admission: Only owning player, same valid instance in constructing state, once; rejected for ready/cancelled/destroyed.
S04.commit: Atomically mark cancelled, remove construction and footprint, release charged population once, invalidate finish, redeem refund receipt once. Do not emit kill/recycle rewards or construction-finish/qualification events.
refundReceipt: precommit current HP and other instance attributes
S04.existingSourceCard: If same source item still in inventory of same valid issuer owned by original player, add 1 charge to that instance. Do not overwrite other charge changes or merge arbitrary same-ID objects.
S04.otherwise: Create exactly one same-type refund item with captured attributes and 1 charge at construction position. If original issuer is alive, owned and can carry, try D01; otherwise leave at construction position. Full inventory leaves this new refund instance on ground at that position. Never reactivate deleted source AND create replacement.
S04.cancellationVersusDestruction: Voluntary cancellation only. Death before finish refunds no card. Ready towers use established recycle rules, never this refund.
S04.sameTimestamp: B05 sequence order. Earlier cancellation invalidates finish; earlier finish makes cancellation reject. Finish is enqueued at commit, so later-enqueued cancellation at same deadline normally loses.
S04.persistence: Persist redeemed receipt/state and ground output identity atomically; duplicate cancel command or load does not redeem twice.

D02.status: Q24 Web choice; not original-client measurement
D02.scope: Ordinary native-shop physical goods; scripted virtual exchange/page menus follow their existing Web/script rules
D02.capacityAdmission: Require at least one actual empty slot before committing purchase, even with an existing same-ID stack-whitelist item or potential recipe. No pre-merge or pre-recipe.
D02.otherAdmission: Keep known buyer eligibility, price/balance, stock, recipient validity. Unknown price remains unknown, never defaults to 0.
D02.rejection: No debit, stock decrement, item creation, sold/pickup event, ground item or stack mutation.
D02.commit: In one queue operation commit known currency and stock, create/install bought item into lowest empty slot, then synchronously execute original pickup processing and its nested effects. Retain script drops/removals; no refund merely because pickup script drops/removes item.
D02.stacking: Only original whitelist, only at original post-recipe Item_Get location, first same-ID other instance from slots0..5; sum charges and remove incoming. Non-whitelist remains separate.
D02.powerupCapacityException: Explicit object powerup=1 bypasses only empty-slot admission, preserving other checks and defined effect. No existing item eviction. Missing powerup retained null in source but receives no capacity exemption by explicit Web policy, not by asserting native default=0.

verification.checks: Parsed object joins, verified relevant incremental fields, checked discard-return bytecode CALL instructions and exact population/charge examples; no game execution.
verification.boundaryExamplesStatus: Static model calculations; not game runtime or original-client tests

constructionEvidence.status: source facts; Web effective duration is separately chosen in S03
constructionEvidence.effectiveNativeDurationReason: Absent custom Dur1/HeroDur1 is not known to fall back to AIbl 30, to unit bldtm 1, or to any other value; map client runtime not identified/tested.
constructionEvidence.finishScriptPredicateForQualification: IsUnitType(unit, UNIT_TYPE_HERO) OR GetUnitTypeId(unit)==n208; not custom UnitIsHero

shopCapacityEvidence.status: source facts about post-pickup stacking; native full-inventory shop admission not measured
shopCapacityEvidence.stackOrder: Existing Item_Get eligibility and recipe processing precede whitelist stacking; HasItem picks first same-ID different instance in slots 0..5; add charges to existing then delete incoming and return.

nativeValidationPlan.requirements: Matching map runtime client and original custom ability SLK rows, not inferred from editor version
nativeValidationPlan.construction: Log issue, start, finish/cancel timestamps, card instance/charges, gold/lumber and used food for original I501 and representative other target races; test failed placement, intermediate cancellation and completion.
nativeValidationPlan.shop: Fill six slots; test ordinary purchases with no match, same-ID whitelist charge item, potential recipe and explicit powerup; record costs, stock, item identities, sold/pickup events.
